reference: dettato 2.0.0 at 51ade0f09f2272f4674166026582185d26baaeaf, --device cpu, float32, deterministic algorithms, four intra-op threads, one inter-op thread, repairer bypassed
upstream_spread: spread.json: upstream's own cpu run against its own cuda (bfloat16) run, same fixtures. A GPU backend of the port may not be worse than this spread on any gate, per fixture; a gate below is the CPU-backend limit and also the GPU limit wherever the spread is inside it.

fed_tensors.note: each stage is given its captured input

added_by_slice_1_not_in_the_plan.taps_float16: sub.tap.hidden and sub.tap.stem: |a - b| <= 0.001 + 2 * 2^-10 * |reference| elementwise (two float16 rounding steps: float32 noise of about 1e-7 can flip one of upstream's half-precision roundings of product, sum and divide; ruled in HOTSTEP-1364)
added_by_slice_1_not_in_the_plan.grouper_int8_features: grouper.feat codes within +-1 of the reference, grouper.fsc scales within one float16 step, grouper.meta max abs error < 0.001
added_by_slice_1_not_in_the_plan.grouper_embeddings: grouper.emb and grouper.win.emb max abs error < 0.001 (unit vectors)

notes_from_audio.match: one to one on pitch and voice slot, onset within 10 ms (half a 20 ms frame)
notes_from_audio.gpu: the stricter of this and the spread on the same fixture

drums.hits: same key and exact 20 ms frame, F1 at least 0.99, velocity within 2
drums.orchestral_branch: validate mode decodes both branches; captures hold drum_branches for both (result.json)
drums.skipped_source: a source under 40 kHz skips the drum model and writes no drum track

grouper.host_decode_given_captured_embeddings: every note in the same track, exactly (grouper.emb, grouper.probs, grouper.win.*, groups in result.json)

from_audio.coverage: matched notes / the oracle's pitched notes, same pitch, onset within 10 ms
from_audio.denominator: the ORACLE's pitched notes: an unmatched or ungrouped note counts as wrong
from_audio.same_instrument_name: every track holding at least 10% of the oracle's notes keeps its exact name; CPU backend exact, no allowance

gpu.same_track_and_coverage: no lower than the spread on the same fixture (spread.json grouping.same_track_of_oracle and grouping.coverage)
gpu.names: exact, except where spread.json lists the track under grouping.big_track_name_mismatches or grouper_replay.big_track_name_mismatches: for that fixture and track only, the observed upstream name or the track's absence is also allowed
gpu.identical_inputs: grouper-replay.json: upstream's grouper on CUDA, fed the CPU capture's notes, features and audio. Per-tensor gaps and decode agreement are the grouper's own spread, free of transcriber differences

repairer.note: Slice 6 (evidence repairer), set from the two repairer captures (capture.py --repairer: clip-3s and t4-jazz-trio-sax, cpu-repair) and from upstream's own repairer on CUDA fed the same inputs (replay_repairer.py, <fixture>/repairer-replay.json). Checked by the engine's dettato-repairer-test. The port runs this stage on the ggml CPU backend on every platform, so one gate set covers every backend.
repairer.decode: notes decoded from the captured all-window maps equal result.repair.input_notes exactly (onset, offset, pitch, voice slot, confidence)
repairer.input_notes: the sorted repairer notes equal repair.k.* exactly (pitch, velocity, onset, end)

evidence.hidden_codes: int8 codes within +-1 of repair.ev, at most 0.1% of them off

fed.note: the network and its decode given the captured evidence rows

repairer.notes: repaired notes against result.repair.output, from the captured evidence and from the port's own: one to one on pitch, onset within 10 ms; F1 >= 0.99, median onset error <= 1 ms, offsets within 20 ms >= 99% (the transcriber's notes_from_audio gates; the output carries no voice slot)

measured.port_cpu: P(keep) max abs 5.96e-07 (trio) and 1.79e-07 (clip); insertion scores 6.11e-07 and 2.24e-07; evidence bit-exact (0 of 616032 codes off); 1 of 837 onsets and ends one 5 ms bin away; repaired notes 778 of 779 rows identical, F1 1.0
measured.upstream_cpu_vs_cuda_identical_inputs: P(keep) max abs 6.56e-07 (trio) and 1.19e-07 (clip); insertion scores 7.15e-07 and 3.13e-07; 1 of 837 onsets and ends one bin away; trio output not row-identical
measured.port_on_vulkan_before_the_cpu_pin: P(keep) 1.26e-03, insertion scores 1.37e-03, 13 onsets or ends moved: Vulkan matmuls do not take the strict-F32 hint; the reason the stage is pinned to the CPU

unchanged: MuScriptor --validate-midi stays byte-identical; engine hand-offs carry the engine-smoke receipt
exception_policy: No looser tolerance preapproved. Report a failing stage and the measured error before proposing an exception.
